description: 彰化縣防空疏散避難設施位置 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 彰化縣警察局. 本資料集提供彰化縣內所有防空疏散避難設施的相關資訊，包含設施位置、容量、管理單位等，可作為防災整備、避難演練、以及地理資訊系統（GIS）空間分析之用途。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 彰化縣警察局. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
